definitions.full: H7088. qaphad [ קָפַד ] verb Pi`el gather together, roll up (Arabic wind turban snugly ; Aramaic קְפַד , , Ithpe`el be drawn in, together ; also קוּפְדָא , , porcupine ; so Arabic () (compare Lag BN 182 ), Ethiopic ); — Perfect 1singular קִמַּדְתִּי Isa 38:12 I have rolled up , like a weaver, my life (i.e. finished it; Buhl Lex 13 תָּ - [of ׳י ], but 3 masculine singular following of ׳י ).
